title: Incheon City Tour Bus 2026: Retro and Sea Lines, Timetables, Prices and Booking
description: Incheon City Tour guide, checked October 2026: the Retro Line (Chinatown, Sinpo Market) and the double-decker Sea Line (Incheon Airport T2, Eurwangni Beach, Paradise City), prices from KRW 9,000, Wednesday–Sunday timetables and where to board in Songdo.
h1Sub: Retro and Sea Line timetables and prices
lead: The Incheon City Tour starts at the Incheon Tourist Information Center in Songdo Central Park. The Retro Line loops through Chinatown, Sinpo International Market and Incheon Art Platform; the double-decker Sea Line visits Incheon Airport Terminal 2, Eurwangni Beach and Paradise City. A combined ticket covers both. It runs Wednesday to Sunday.
summary: Retro Line (minibus, about 1 h 30 min) · Sea Line (double-decker, about 2 h 35 min)
Wednesday to Sunday (closed Mon, Tue and Lunar New Year and Chuseok days) · hourly
Retro KRW 9,000 · Sea KRW 14,000 · combined KRW 16,000 (adult)
Incheon Tourist Information Center (Central Park Station, Incheon Line 1, exit 3)
Online until the day before · on-site tickets on the day · first come, first served

routes.name: Retro Line
stops: Incheon Tourist Information Center (Songdo Central Park)
routes.tip: Chinatown, Jayu Park and the open-port streets are an easy walk from the Incheon Station stop. Runs as a minibus.

routes.name: Sea Line
stops: Incheon Tourist Information Center (Songdo Central Park)
routes.tip: There is a stop at Incheon Airport Terminal 2 (near exit 6, ground floor). Double-decker; Eurwangni Beach and the Muuido entrance have the best sea views.

tickets.name: Retro Line
tickets.price: KRW 9,000 adult · KRW 7,000 child, senior, group
includes: Hop-on hop-off on the Retro Line

tickets.name: Sea Line
tickets.price: KRW 14,000 adult · KRW 12,000 child, senior, group
includes: Hop-on hop-off on the Sea Line

tickets.name: Combined (Retro + Sea)
tickets.price: KRW 16,000 adult · KRW 14,000 child, senior, group

priceNote: Prices from the official Incheon City Tour booking site on 29 October 2026. Children are 36 months to under 19; seniors 65+; under 36 months ride free. Short-term discounts are common, so check the booking page.
howToBook: Open the official booking page (Korean only) with the button below and choose a line.
Online booking is possible until the day before; on the day, buy tickets on site. Bookings must be paid by midnight on the booking day.
Refunds: 100% up to 3 days before, 70% 1–2 days before, 50% on the day.
howToRide: Board at the Incheon Tourist Information Center outside exit 3 of Central Park Station (Incheon Line 1).
If you booked, show ID (a passport for visitors) at the center before boarding.
Scan the QR code of your ticket or mobile voucher when boarding; you can hop on and off that line all day.
Seats are first come, first served and standing is not allowed.

faq.q: Which days does the Incheon City Tour run?
faq.a: Wednesday to Sunday. It is closed every Monday and Tuesday and on Lunar New Year and Chuseok days.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Sea Line and the Retro Line?
faq.a: The Retro Line is a 1 h 30 min minibus loop through Chinatown and old Incheon; the Sea Line is a 2 h 35 min double-decker loop to Incheon Airport T2, Eurwangni Beach and Paradise City.

faq.q: Can I board at Incheon Airport?
faq.a: Yes, the Sea Line stops at Terminal 2, near exit 6 on the ground floor.

faq.q: Is the combined ticket worth it?
faq.a: If you ride both lines, yes: KRW 16,000 instead of KRW 23,000 for two separate adult tickets.
